chats.answer:
For a 17-inch laptop, I'd recommend a screen extender with a 16–17.3-inch display, ideally with 1920×1200 or 1920×1080 resolution.

The biggest consideration is compatibility: many popular laptop screen extenders are designed for 13–16-inch laptops and won't securely attach to a 17-inch model.

There are two main styles:

Laptop-mounted extenders: Attach directly to your laptop screen, giving you a dual- or triple-monitor setup. Best for compact workspaces.

Portable monitors with stands: Sit beside your laptop rather than attaching to it. Usually lighter on your laptop hinges, more stable, and better for a large 17-inch machine.
